text: Chinese painting is a core category of traditional Chinese art. It uses media such as brushes, ink, and Xuan paper, integrating poetry, calligraphy, painting, and seal engraving. It emphasizes the expression of "artistic conception" and "charm". This major aims to inherit the essence of Chinese culture and cultivate professional talents with traditional painting techniques, art theories and innovation capabilities. It covers classic painting genres such as landscape, flower-and-bird and figure painting, and at the same time explores the contemporary transformation of traditional painting in combination with modern art concepts.
